lines.en: Flying low over the snow keeps me warmer.
Zebra stripes run across my wings.
Snow grains sting my wing membrane.
A layer of frost settles on my black wings.
The snow is too bright. My eyes blur.
I skirt around the frozen pond.
A gap has opened in the snow.
A rest on the pine branch, then on.
The snow is deep; land and you sink.
The sun is low — I must fly on.
This gully blocks the wind — this way.
Cold wind pushes back; I beat my wings slowly.
Over the snowfield, where did the clouds go?
One wingbeat carries me three paces.
The snow is so bright I squint.
I follow the warm current along the ridge.
Fine ice forms in the seams of my wings.
Distant thunder over the snow — muffled.
Who's walking on the snow?
So cold — are there any flowers left?
I spread my wings to the sun.

lines.zh: 雪一样白的翅，夜里更亮。
lines.en: Snow-white wings shine brighter at night.
Nectar in the cold air; I smell it.
The snow stopped; the wind has not.
I huddle up like a dead leaf.
My stripes stand out against the snow.

lines.zh: 雪原上的我，条纹是黑的。
lines.en: On the snowfield, my stripes are black.
I'll fly once my wings warm up.
Your breath clouds are huge.

lines.zh: 下面那个会走路的，别动。
lines.en: That walking thing below — hold still.
I hang here, just watching you.
My wing stripes look like a zebra's.

lines.zh: 雪原上的白，比我的翅还亮。
lines.en: Snowfield white outshines my wings.

lines.zh: 我翅上的长条，像斑马纹。
lines.en: The long bands on my wings look like zebra stripes.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩碎了我的雪。
lines.en: Your boots crushed my snow.
Don't swat — these wings break.
The name's Zebra Longwing Butterfly, remember.
You smell of pine resin.
Who swung that? Heavy hand.
It hurts; give me a moment.
The pain makes my wing twitch.
Numb with cold, and now this.
I shake my wings — still moving.
There's a tear in my wing membrane.
I fall into the snow, flipped over.
Easy. My wings are thin.

lines.zh: 雪原上的白，把我的翅色洗淡了。
lines.en: Snowfield white washed out my wing color.
Blood on my stripes.
Where is that sweetness coming from?

lines.zh: 积雪针叶林里，飞得很慢。
lines.en: In the snowy taiga, I fly very slowly.
Don't take it away — I'm slow.
Shivering cold, and still hungry.
One small drop — one lick.
You've got honey on your hands.
My wings go weak — I just want a taste.
Long wings are heavy work in snow.
On the snowfield, long wings drift.
Nectar? In this weather?
A clump of snow falls and hits me.
Snow walls on both sides — let me by.
One bump and a sheet of frost falls.
A white crease folds into my wing.
Over the snowplain, the wind arrives before me.
My wing colours are too bright against the snow.

lines.zh: 雪地上撞两回，翅都白了。
lines.en: Two bumps in the snow and my wings are white.
My wingtip hits a pine needle.
I didn't see — I hit you.
Who planted a post here?
Over the snow, we fly side by side.
Wings, a little closer.
Slow down — I can keep up.
Two black wings, circling as one.
Snow falls on my wings; I do not shake it off.
Follow me to the pine.

lines.zh: 雪原上，我的翅纹像斑马。
lines.en: On the snowfield my wings look striped.
Our wing patterns match — I know you.
In this cold, only you wait for me.

lines.zh: 雪地上我的条纹太长，藏不住。
lines.en: On snow my long stripes give me away.
This one — I keep it first.
In the cold, my wing pattern grows longer.
This dead leaf will line the nest.

lines.zh: 这片花瓣，我抱着飞一段。
lines.en: I carry this petal a while.
Long wings spread, the stripes break.
Do not blame me if it drops; the snow is slick.
Whose shiny flake? Mine.

lines.zh: 积雪上，长翅飞得很吃力。
lines.en: Over snow, these long wings struggle.
I carry it with my legs.
A frozen bug — I'll take it.
That dark speck on the snow — you.
A drop from above works best.
Wings spread and ready.
On the snow beach, dark wings with white spots.
Today's prey is a decent size.
Your warmth draws me in.
I reached this spot first.
Your shadow moves, and I know.
On the snowfield, my wings flash open.
Don't go — I've got you.
Wherever you go, wings follow.
I fly slowly, but I keep flying.
A little closer and I'm there.
You can't outrun wings.

lines.zh: 我压低高度，贴着雪面飞。
lines.en: I drop low, skimming the snow.
The cold wind pushes me along.
I sink lower, slowly.

lines.zh: 雪原太亮，我的翅是黑的。
lines.en: The snowfield is bright; my wings are black.
The snow glare lets me see clearly.
Fine stripes, all carried on these wings.
Snowflakes land on my wings and stay.

lines.zh: 我翅上的长条，飞起来才展开。
lines.en: My long wing bands only open in flight.
I dive down from the snow.
I dive and pin you down.
My wing bones are hard — try them.
I'll hit your face — don't blame me.
Don't grab me — I bite.
Back off — don't push me.
Even in snow I'll fight.
This wingbeat will knock you askew.
My long wings settle on the snow first.
The first gust cuts like a blade.
I climb out of a chrysalis under the snow.
Long wings out, I fly far.
I land on a snowdrift and hold.
Cold — but I'm not afraid.
Wings frozen stiff — I unfold them slowly.
Wings on the snowfield shine white.
One spread of these long wings and I go far.
The white here has no edge.
One lick of flame and my wings curl.
Falling down a snow slope, dazed.
Water on my wings drags me down.

lines.zh: 雪地里，我的翅冻得发脆。
lines.en: In the snow, my wings go brittle with cold.
On the snowfield my wings open and close.
The spell clings, and my wings feel heavy.
Not a single flower on this snowfield.
Lightning struck — my wings are singed.
No snow, no wind.
